2607.07379.title: Physics-Audited Agentic Discovery in Scientific Machine Learning
2607.07379.paper_summary: In agentic scientific machine learning (SciML), large language model (LLM) agents can discover surrogate models and select one by an automated score, typically an error metric. A low error, however, does not establish that the predicted fields satisfy the physics that matter for mechanics, such as boundary conditions, superposition, stiffness scaling, or causality. We introduce Physics-Audited Agentic SciML (PA-SciML), a verification-first workflow for agentic SciML discovery. The workflow fixes a scoring evaluator before search, derives reviewable machine-checkable physics requirements, checks each trained candidate on its outputs, and separately searches prescribed input ranges or measured load-history spans for high-violation cases without reference solution fields. A surrogate is reported as verified only under the stated checks. When enabled, the workflow also adds advisory numerical probes before training and tests one modeling change at a time to record which isolated edits are associated with score gains before reuse. In the reported computational-solid-mechanics numerical examples, the static elasticity run selects a surrogate with lower validation error than the error-only baseline while both selected models pass the common linear-elastic checks. In the transient elastodynamics run, an error-only baseline with similar mean error fails a stricter causality check by responding to future parts of the loading history, while the selected surrogate passes the stated checks. The main distinction is per-candidate physics evidence on predicted fields, not a richer aggregate score.
2607.07379.paper_summary_zh: 在代理科學機器學習（SciML）中，大型語言模型（LLM）代理可以發現替代模型並通過自動化評分（通常是誤差指標）來選擇一個。然而，低誤差並不代表預測的場滿足對於力學重要的物理條件，例如邊界條件、疊加原理、剛度縮放或因果關係。我們引入了物理審核的代理SciML（PA-SciML），這是一個以驗證為先的代理SciML發現工作流程。該工作流程在搜索之前固定評分評估器，推導可審查的機器可檢查物理要求，檢查每個訓練候選者的輸出，並分別搜索規定的輸入範圍或測量的負載歷史跨度，以尋找高違規案例，而不參考解決方案場。只有在滿足上述檢查的情況下，替代品才會被報告為已驗證。當啟用時，該工作流程還會在訓練之前添加建議的數值探針，並一次測試一個建模變更，以記錄哪些孤立的編輯與分數增益相關，然後再重用。在報告的計算固體力學數值示例中，靜態彈性運行選擇了一個驗證誤差低於僅誤差基準的替代品，而兩個選擇的模型都通過了共同的線性彈性檢查。在瞬態彈性動力學運行中，具有相似平均誤差的僅誤差基準未能通過更嚴格的因果檢查，因為它對加載歷史的未來部分做出了反應，而所選的替代品則通過了所述檢查。主要區別在於每個候選者對預測場的物理證據，而不是更豐富的綜合分數。
